title: KGCS Agent Response Envelope
description: Canonical response envelope for all KGCS agent responses. All three specialist agents and the orchestrator return payloads conforming to this schema.

version.description: Schema version. Version bump required for breaking changes to the envelope.

correlation_id.description: UUID propagated end-to-end for audit and tracing.

status.description: ok: data returned; empty: valid query but no rows; error: non-recoverable failure.

data.description: Agent-specific payload. Validated separately against the per-agent response schema (systems-response.json, offensive-response.json, defensive-response.json).

provenance.description: Source attribution for all data in this response. Required to have at least one entry when status is 'ok'.

source.description: Authoritative data source name, e.g. 'NVD', 'MITRE ATT&CK', 'MITRE CAPEC'.

ids.description: Canonical IDs from the source that contributed to this response.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the source record at time of ingestion.

confidence.description: Confidence computation per the confidence-model spec maintained in kgcs-server.

value.description: Scalar confidence 0–1. Computed per confidence model spec.

basis.description: Basis for the confidence value. COMPLETE_CHAIN = full causal path traversed.

signals.description: Raw signals used to compute confidence.value.

rows.description: Number of result rows returned by the Cypher template.

hops.description: Number of causal chain hops traversed (max 6 for full chain).

shape_validated.description: Whether the query result was cross-checked against SHACL shapes.

freshness_days.description: Days since the most recently modified source record. Values > 365 trigger a 0.1 confidence penalty.

degradation.description: Ordered list of applied confidence penalties, e.g. ['missing_hop:capec', 'stale_data'].

errors.description: Present (and non-empty) when status is 'error'. Contains human-readable error messages.
